verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own materials describe publishing changelogs to a standalone, branded page with a custom domain and to embeddable in-product widgets. They also cover email subscriptions, release notes targeted by user attributes, and automatic notification of users when their requests ship, which closes the loop with customers. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on writing and publishing changelog entries (the evidence is marketing taglines only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can publish a changelog announcing shipped features to close the loop with customers

citations.quote: Serve your changelogs from a standalone page with a custom domain and fully brand it. Subscribe users to email updates.
Showcase new updates directly within your product and website with our embeddable changelog widgets.
Segment your product releases by user attributes to always send out targeted release notes.
Featurebase automatically notifies all relevant users when their requests are shipped. No more manual follow-ups.
